description: Variation of conditions 2 (Approved plans), 4 (Parking/servicing),5 (External materials), 6 (Landscaping & boundary treatment), 7 (Area for storage bins) and 8 (Secure cycle parking) to allow:Replacement of brickwork with render to front, side and rearAlteration to roof profile and height of front porchAlteration to front, side and rear fenestrationInstallation of steps to rear of dwellingAlterations to landscaping, boundary fencing, refuse and cycle storage arrangementsAlteration to rear loading bay of approved appeal decision reference: APP/T5150/W/22/3296875, dated 01/11/2022, relating to Full Planning Permission reference: 21/3094, dated 12/10/2021 for Demolition of single storey storage unit located within the rear service yard of 228 Church Lane and erection of a two storey dwellinghouse with alterations to Church Lane frontage to include new front terrace, the insertion of an additional entrance door and fenestration to rear to access new dwelling
